title: MTC CA Operator Disclosures Schema
description: Schema for MTC CA and Mirroring Operator disclosures supporting per-key and global disclosure URLs.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp indicating when this manifest was last updated.

global_disclosures.description: Operator-wide disclosures applicable across all operations and CA Cosigner Keys.

ca_repository_url.description: URL to the Operator's public repository where items like policy documents, Subscriber agreements, certificate profiles, and historical revisions reside.

legal_entity_and_ownership_url.description: URL detailing legal entity status, beneficial ownership, and corporate control.

operational_status_url.description: URL to public operational status reporting pages.

facility_certification_url.description: URL to ISO/IEC 27001, AICPA SOC 2 Type II / SOC 3, or equivalent facility audit certification. Required when applying or operating as an MTC CA Operator.

ca_cosigner_keys.description: List of disclosures specific to each CA Cosigner Key included in the CQRS. May be omitted by applicants initially onboarding solely as a Mirroring Operator.

friendly_name.description: Human-readable name for the CA Cosigner Key.

key_sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the CA Cosigner Key's DER-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo (SPKI).

disclosures.description: Key-specific disclosure URLs and CRL Distribution Points.

policy_documents_url.description: URL to the Markdown/AsciiDoc combined CP/CPS governing this key.

reserve_keys_url.description: URL disclosing anticipated Reserve CA Cosigner Keys for this key lineage.

key_generation_attestation_url.description: URL to the Key Generation Ceremony Attestation report for this key.

infrastructure_architecture_url.description: URL describing infrastructure architecture and geographic diversity for this key.

facility_certification_url.description: Optional override URL for facility certification if this key is hosted in a distinct facility.

full_crl_urls.description: Array of HTTP URLs for all Full (complete) CRLs issued by this CA Cosigner Key. MUST be an empty array ([]) if this key only issues partitioned CRLs or is an offline Reserve key.

partitioned_crl_urls.description: Array of HTTP URLs for all Partitioned CRLs issued by this CA Cosigner Key. MUST be an empty array ([]) if this key only issues full CRLs or is an offline Reserve key.
